description: This file defines a custom exception class EmailCampaignMustBeClosedToEditException in the email campaign module of Apache Fineract. The exception indicates that an email campaign cannot be edited unless it is in a 'Closed' state.

classes.name: EmailCampaignMustBeClosedToEditException
classes.description: Custom exception thrown when an attempt is made to edit an email campaign that is not in the 'Closed' state.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the exception with a specific error message indicating the campaign resource ID that cannot be updated because it is not in the 'Closed' state.

calls: super("error.msg.email.campaign.cannot.be.updated", "Campaign with identifier " + resourceId + " cannot be updated as it is not in `Closed` state.", resourceId)
